notes.en:
• Security notice: pause installation of WcSdAi 1.1.0. Security patch 1.1.1 is being prepared and must pass validation before release.
• A high-severity Undici failure has been reproduced and can terminate the Agent subprocess, interrupting tasks. No credential disclosure or code execution has been demonstrated.
• Do not downgrade to 1.0.5 as a security workaround; it contains the same affected dependency.
• The download link opens the release page with the current warning. Installation remains manual; the app does not automatically install updates.
notes.zh-CN:
• 安全提示：请暂缓安装 WcSdAi 1.1.0。正在准备安全修复版 1.1.1，通过验证后再发布。
• Undici 高危问题已复现，可导致 Agent 子进程退出、任务中断。目前未证实凭据泄露或代码执行。
• 不建议通过降级至 1.0.5 规避风险，该版本包含同样受影响的依赖。
• 下载按钮仍进入发布页，请先阅读安全提示。安装保持手动进行，客户端不会自动安装更新。
